ordered items: Go to the Page gallery,Click the "Add Page" button,Select the "new landing page",Enter a name for the page and save

Create a chart: drag and drop a visualisation component into a new section or an existing one,"Edit the chart: change the title, define the chart axes, change the appearance, and more","Create the data: For now, chart data is is stored in the Statistical chart data table. It is possible to create data points using the form, but this method is still under development. Instead, we recommend to create the chart data outside of the page builder. You can either use the forms in the Statistical chart data table or import data from a csv or excel file. If you are using the file method, copy the chart ID and paste it to the displayed in chart column"
